messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=private-vpc-controlplane severity=page. Symptoms=customer-facing control plane API 503/504 to private deployments in eu-west-1. Pager: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: page fired -> Escalation policy: Private-VPC-Oncall -> Alex (page 1)

Alex (oncall-sre): acked. I'm on it, pulling logs and checking network path. Can someone add customer account id (acct-8723) and VPC CIDR?

Raj (cust-succ): acct-8723, vpc-cidr=10.2.0.0/16. Customer reporting "control plane not reachable" and timeouts starting ~09:12 UTC.

Maria (eng-infra): noted. I'm running control plane health checks from our private control plane collector in eu-west-1. Quick check: `curl -v https://cp.internal.eu-west-1.redwood/api/health` -> `504 Gateway Timeout`.

Alex (oncall-sre): running traceroute to the customer's VPC endpoint from a colocated host:```
traceroute to 10.2.0.45 (10.2.0.45), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.1.0.1  0.7 ms  0.6 ms  0.6 ms
 2  100.64.0.23  1.2 ms  1.2 ms  1.3 ms
 3  * * *
 4  * * *
```

Alex (oncall-sre): looks like route blackhole after the provider NAT. Could be a transit/VPC route issue. Anyone with AWS console access to check route tables / VGW?

Sam (oncall-ops): I can jump in. Checking customer VPC route table for 10.2.0.0/16. Also checking our on-prem agent heartbeat to that customer's agent.

Maria (eng-infra): FYI metrics show control-plane egress errors spiking at 09:11:43 UTC across a subset of eu-west-1 nodes, and BGP flaps from partner connection 10.254.x.x around same time.

Raj (cust-succ): Customer says they didn't change anything on their side. They're on a managed transit provider. Escalating to their network ops now.

Sam (oncall-ops): Found a stale route on our side in the private-controlplane-egress RT: destination 10.2.0.0/16 -> blackhole (propagated false). I'm going to remove the explicit blackhole route and force propagation. Will coordinate with infra.

Maria (eng-infra): Before we touch routes, snapshot current RT and export config. `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=private-controlplane-egress` -> saving to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1915002468/rt-snapshot.json

Alex (oncall-sre): Good. If Sam is touching route tables, please add a quick smoke check after change: `curl -sS -m 5 https://cp.internal.eu-west-1.redwood/api/health || echo "down"` repeated from 3 hosts.

Sam (oncall-ops): Removing the blackhole route now (propagation still enabled). Applying change.

incident-bot: configuration-change: route-table/private-controlplane-egress removed route (10.2.0.0/16 -> blackhole) by Sam at 09:20 UTC. Audit: https://audit.example/changes/CHG-9981

Alex (oncall-sre): running the smoke checks...

Maria (eng-infra): health checks now returning 200 OK from 2/3 probes, one probe still timing out (maybe local SG). Latencies low.

Raj (cust-succ): Customer reports control plane connectivity restored on their side. They see successful API responses now.

Alex (oncall-sre): Observability shows request success rate back to normal and errors falling. Marking initial mitigation successful.

Maria (eng-infra): Noted BGP flaps — we should follow up with partner to understand why the route propagations showed up as blackhole. I'll open a post-incident task.

Sam (oncall-ops): I'll follow up with ops runbook to add a guard: detect blackhole route -> auto-creator alert but not immediate deletion without human ack. For now, changed to manual removal.

Alex (oncall-sre): Severity update: P1 (customer-facing outage for single customer in eu-west-1). Impact: single-customer private control plane API unreachable for ~9 minutes (09:11–09:20 UTC). Customer impact assessed as partial outage.

Raj (cust-succ): Customer satisfied with restoration but asked for RCA and timeline. I'll own comms and request detailed RCA and follow-up steps.

Maria (eng-infra): Action items: 1) RCA (network partner + route propagation) assigned to infra team (Maria). 2) Postmortem draft (Alex). 3) Runbook updates (Sam). 4) Customer-facing RCA (Raj).

Alex (oncall-sre): handing off to overnight oncall, Sam will be primary for any followups. I'm going to mark incident acknowledged -> mitigated and start the postmortem doc.

Sam (oncall-ops): ack handoff. I'll create Handoff note in #incidents-handoffs and monitor for 2 hours.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated. Status=mitigated, mitigated_by=Sam, mitigation_time=09:20 UTC. Incident link: https://incidents.example/INC-2026-1915002468

Alex (oncall-sre): closing thread here, adding timeline to postmortem. If anything regresses ping me. :thumbsup:
